title: Unsupported docker/setup-buildx-action runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve the builder driver, version, and endpoint inputs; Node 24 needs Actions Runner v2.327.1 or later on self-hosted runners.

steps.title: Upgrade setup-buildx-action
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to docker/setup-buildx-action@v4 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review setup-buildx-action inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options; confirm the runner meets the release's minimum version.
